9c54829b: This line creates an entry in the array DQ, with the key being the value from the variable DQ. The value being stored is a concatenation of several variables (DLB, DV, DU, DW) separated by the 'U' character, followed by the entire routine text associated with the label 'X' concatenated with 'DQ'. The routine text is obtained by executing the $T function, which returns the text of the routine containing the specified label. The $P function is used to extract the routine text, excluding the first piece (which is the label itself).
